purpose: Teach: モットー/貸与/累計/問屋/立ち寄り/小売り/衣料/言明

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時のモットーを大事にされた
lines.en: Dad really held fast to his founding motto.
lines.style: Steady, measured voice. Slight pause before speaking, as if retrieving memory. Warm but not sentimental. The tone of someone honouring a legacy they've studied and understood.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員に機材を貸与する制度を作られた
lines.en: Yes. He created a system where the company would loan equipment to staff.
lines.style: Clear, direct response. Matter-of-fact delivery that carries quiet pride. Slight emphasis on the practical nature of the gesture—not abstract values, but real support.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、累計実績を社員に共有された
lines.en: Dad would share the company's cumulative results with every employee.
lines.style: Gentle admiration in the voice. Slower pace, as if painting a picture of something he witnessed. Slight wistfulness—the tone of remembering something good that's past.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは問屋との信頼を築かれました
lines.en: Yes. He built real trust with our wholesalers.
lines.style: Respectful, measured cadence. Not boasting—simply stating fact with understated conviction. The voice of someone reflecting on what trust actually meant in practice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、お取引先に立ち寄りで顔を出される習慣だったぞ
lines.en: Dad made a habit of stopping by to see the business partners in person.
lines.style: Warm, almost affectionate recollection. Slight rise in energy as if the memory itself brings him back to that time. The fondness of remembering a small, consistent kindness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは小売りの現場を大事にされました
lines.en: Yes. He understood that the retail floor was where it truly mattered.
lines.style: Thoughtful, deliberate. Emphasis lands gently on 'truly mattered'—the insight that action speaks louder than policy. Composed but touched by the memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、衣料事業から始められたぞ
lines.en: Dad started us in the clothing business.
lines.style: Simple statement, slightly nostalgic. The voice of looking back at origins. No fanfare—just fact, held with quiet respect for how far it has come.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社是を明確に言明されました
lines.en: Yes. He stated the company's principles clearly, so everyone knew what we stood for.
lines.style: Final, settling tone. Slightly fuller voice than before—a conclusion. Calm conviction. The words of someone who has lived by those principles and is passing them forward.
